old_problem: The expected Completion Timeout was labeled uncorrectable yet read from ERRCORSTS, while port/X-Y, `uce` mapping, severity and recovery were unresolved.
disposition_reason: PCIe AER places Completion Timeout mask 0x00004000 (bit 14) in Uncorrectable Error Status, while Correctable Error Status bit 0 is Receiver Error. The review therefore corrects only the review-layer oracle to ERRUNCSTS/Uncorrectable Status and preserves the Master text historically. ED-03 binds PCH topology and vendor selector at runtime; ED-16 gates the single UCE injection and recovery.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 37, same-row AI fields, historical record 2440 and next pending row 38.
Consulted PCI-SIG AER register layout and the Linux PCI register definitions: CTE is PCI_ERR_UNC_COMP_TIME 0x00004000 under Uncorrectable Error Status; Receiver Error is Correctable Status bit 0.
Preserved PCH CTE/UCE identity and did not substitute row-36 Receiver Error evidence.
Required current severity/mask and exact endpoint recovery rather than assuming non-fatal behavior.
No injection, register write or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Inject one approved Completion Timeout on a mapped PCH port and verify Uncorrectable Error Status bit 14 with bounded severity and complete endpoint/link recovery.
required_package: Supported package hash and proof `uce` selects Completion Timeout
ERRUNCSTS bit14 mask/severity and ownership pre-state
Windows WHEA/AER, endpoint/link recovery and applicable platform oracle
OOB abort, recovery and BIOS restoration
test_case.test_command: For a quiesced mapped PCH endpoint, capture Uncorrectable Status/Mask/Severity, link and driver baseline; allow the FAE to execute one vendor-proven CTE stimulus; record ERRUNCSTS bit14 (0x00004000), Windows AER/WHEA and any conditional management indication; verify bounded recovery and restore settings. Do not use ERRCORSTS as the CTE oracle.
test_case.expected_result: The intended PCH port asserts uncorrectable CTE bit14 and matching OS evidence at the approved severity, then returns the endpoint/link and host to healthy baseline with applicable platform indications reconciled.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target mapping, vendor CTE semantics, ERRUNCSTS 0x00004000, expected severity, OS correlation and complete recovery. ERRCORSTS bit0, generic UCE text, wrong port, unexpected fatality or persistent device loss fails.
safety_gate: Quiesce the endpoint and prove independent OOB access.
Verify bit, mask/severity and recovery before one injection.
Abort on wrong status bit, severity escalation, host reset or failed link/device recovery.
No automatic retry; retain raw AER registers.
expected_evidence: Signed PCH target map and package hash
Raw Uncorrectable Status/Mask/Severity before and after
Full injector and Windows AER/WHEA transcript
Endpoint/link recovery plus applicable BMC/UEFI/indicator evidence
test_case.recovery: Stop after any unexpected severity or recovery failure, preserve uncorrectable-status and OOB evidence, execute only the approved endpoint/platform recovery, restore BIOS/AER state and verify service before another authorization.
